name: Azeroth Companion
title: Talent Forge Overdrive — Visual Builder & Draft Controls
features: Reorganized the official Blizzard class, specialization and hero talent nodes into a coordinate-aware visual talent grid
Added a compact card view and search by talent names, descriptions and node IDs
Added multi-step Undo and Redo for manual rank and choice edits
Added a configurable personal allocation reminder, clearly separated from Blizzard's game-validation rules
Preserved v2.3 saved build storage, portable JSON drafts, and original item/character/loot workflows
Improved small-screen scrolling and reduced clutter in talent exploration
